title: P0 — Professional Portfolio
description: A concise professional surface, separate from the Learning Site and awaiting learner-approved details.

sections.title: Purpose
paragraphs: The professional portfolio is a distinct public product under apps/portfolio/. It is intended to communicate professional positioning, systems-thinking, and selected work only after the learner has reviewed that material for accuracy and publication safety.

It links to the Principal Accelerator Learning Site for the public PA-S001 chapter. It does not duplicate the chapter, portray editorial content as professional achievement, or include employer-confidential material.

sections.title: Current P0 slice
paragraphs: The generated /portfolio/ route has its own navigation and contains only a draft professional position, selected-work placeholders, a systems and architecture direction placeholder, and a Learning Site link. The portfolio and Learning Site intentionally do not share one navigation surface.
This is a static-hosting scaffold. It does not establish a final framework, professional narrative, contact endpoint, outcome, or deployment target.

sections.title: Evidence status
paragraphs: No portfolio accomplishments, metrics, testimonials, employer details, mastery results, or production evidence are asserted here. Repository checks can verify bounded rendering behavior; they cannot verify professional claims or learner mastery.
